Sam Irving: Hey folks! Im Sam (he/him), first day on infra observability. Big fan of late-night ramen, plant rescues, and ridiculously loud rainboots. Looking forward to meeting everyone
Jules Park: welcome Sam!! :tada: ramen buddy here. favorite spot is two blocks from the office
Priya Singh: hi Sam  welcome!! we have a tiny plant shelf swap next week if you want to snag a new green friend :seedling:
Omar Zia: welcome! quick logistics Q: any dietary restrictions for the welcome lunch tomorrow? also pinging @facilities-bot for badge access
facilityies-bot: (Note: automated message) Badge request received for Sam Irving. Pickup at reception by 10:00. Temporary access: 5F, kitchen, rooftop terrace. 
Sam Irving: no dietary restrictions, but Im allergic to shellfish (noted). ramen recommendations appreciated :ramen: 
Dana Lee: hey Sam, welcome! Theres a small ramen crawl this Friday after work if you want to join. Also bring rainboots to the rooftop garden day on Saturday (it gets muddy sometimes) 
Jules Park: shellfish-free recs: try Ichikos miso bowl, ask for the vegan tare 
Priya Singh: added you to the plant-swap thread. Also FYI we label plants with names + care notes so you dont overwater 
Sam Irving: love that. Mochi (my rescue fern) will be thrilled. Thanks for the warm welcome 
Omar Zia: badge update: reception says ready. Ill swing by and grab it if youre still on campus later. Also FYI we have a tiny sock drawer in the kitchen for novelty rainboots 
Sam Irving: amazing, see you all soon 
Dana Lee: welcome again! well post meetup details in #general and drop a sticky on your desk :wave:
